# Regtest and txindex: src/chainparams.cpp:1457-1523; src/init.cpp:617-620,3797-3800.
regtest=1
txindex=1
# Server and loopback binding: src/init.cpp:1342-1378; src/httpserver.cpp:220-245.
server=1
rpcbind=127.0.0.1
rpcallowip=127.0.0.1
# Isolation: src/init.cpp:711-735,830-837,3688-3689,4120;
# regtest has empty seeds: src/chainparams.cpp:1520-1523. No addnode/connect.
listen=0
dnsseed=0
discover=0
upnp=0
# Expiry witness: src/validation.cpp:853-856; debug category selection src/init.cpp:2288-2304.
# Logging: src/init.cpp:2042,2288-2304,3507-3510. Console captured in the owned datadir.
printtoconsole=1
shrinkdebugfile=1
# Required launch inputs: src/bitcoind.cpp:140-164. Size supplied per run.
maxstackmemoryusageconsensus=100000000
minminingtxfee=0.00000500
# Cookie authentication: src/httprpc.cpp:341-351. No credentials here.
rpcport=18571
port=18572
excessiveblocksize=1000001
debug=mempool
